newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Hotels to change of year end date.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Hotels to change of year end date.

text.p: Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd said on Monday the company's board of directors was considering changing its fiscal year end date to December 31 from July 31.
"They were considering a change of accounting year end from 31st July to 31st December," the company said in a statement.

"The change of year end to 31st December can assist the company in comparing its financial results with other listed hotel companies, most of which adopt 31st December as their year end date," it said.
Lai Sun Hotels said such a change had been approved by the board and a board meeting would be held on April 23 to approve the audited results for the five months period ended December 31, 1996.
